notes: Two 700 mm 20 x 20 anodised aluminium profiles at X +/-113, inside gap 206; two 246 mm cross bars at Y +/-300, exactly 50 mm inboard. Four real undercut 6 mm T-slot mouths per profile, chosen 8.5 mm cavities/5 mm depth and through core bores; 0.3 mm three-segment profile edge breaks. Cross bars are below the rails so they do not block the tray travel. The 40 x 40 x 30 stop is at Y-300, atop the negative-end cross bar, with a 5 mm black rubber bumper facing +Y and original yellow/black 45-degree tape printed on its top. Mass is estimated (1.0 kg frame, 0.13 kg stop); section 3.3 gives no rail-set mass. Frame friction is 0.25 for the tray; stop friction is 0.9. Five prescribed convex proxies total: four full rectangular profile envelopes and one stop/bumper envelope. The general 1 mm collision fidelity rule is incompatible with one convex proxy per undercut profile: T slots and core bores are deliberately filled in these proxies. Integration constraint in the literal dimensions: a 200 mm tray is narrower than the 206 mm rail gap; these profiles are lateral guides and do not support its floor along the travel. The scene must provide a continuous sliding support plane flush with the cross-bar tops (rail-set local Z20), or an independently designed support. No unrequested support slab or change to the specified 206 mm gap is baked into this prop. The Y+250 suggested tray start extends 50 mm beyond the +Y rail end; the support surface must cover that overhang. Rigid bolted profiles and the fixed stop share the prop frame; no joint or free body is required for the rail set. Metres, Z up, front -X, bottom-centre origin shared by every part and proxy. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree smoothing and nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlases. 64-sample CPU Cycles base colour * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), saved as 8-bit sRGB, without lighting or highlights. Full Principled PBR, source markings and procedural wear remain packed in source.blend. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
